verdict.rationale: Perplexity's own docs show a single API covering the whole research flow. The Agent API runs built-in web search and URL fetch tools and returns the results inline. Pro Search performs multi-step reasoning, running multiple web searches and fetching URL content to answer complex queries. Responses come back as web-grounded answers with citations. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the multi-step search→extract→synthesize flow working end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent run a multi-step research flow — search, extract contents, and synthesize — through one API

citations.quote: Perplexity-hosted capabilities: web search, URL fetch, people and finance search, and a code sandbox. Enable each by `type`, and Perplexity runs it and returns the results inline.
When enabled, the model can perform multiple web searches and fetch URL content to answer complex queries.
Get accurate, up-to-date answers grounded in real-time web search, with inline citations in a single call
